final_message:
I've written the June 2026 draft report for ABC Inc and saved it to `evals/runs/commit3-run-20261012/b_abc_rounding_vanished_lines/skill_output/`:
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.md` is the draft report, with my 7 commentary bullets in section 1 and the "DRAFT" banner left in.
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.json` holds the full analysis. Every figure in the commentary comes from it or from the report's tables; I didn't calculate anything myself.

**Data quality:** every check passed. The subtotals, gross profit, operating income and net income all match the workbook's own rows, and the balance sheet balances in every month. The sheet's structure didn't need any reconstruction, and June is not flagged as a partial month.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue:** 195,898, down 6.0% from May. May (208,351) was the highest month in the workbook, so the drop is measured from a peak. Revenue is 0.5% below the prior 6-month average and 2.8% above June 2025. Gross margin was 70.2%, up 3.1 percentage points from May but 4.2 points below June 2025.
- **Expense lines at zero:** two lines are zero for the first time in June: Federal & State Taxes and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous. Two others have been zero for longer: Advisory Services since February 2026 and Professional Fees since April 2026. The commentary keeps these two cases separate.
- **Net income:** June shows a loss of 330,756, the sixth negative month in a row, and the trailing-twelve-month total is a loss of 3,089,780. December 2025 was the only positive month, and only because of a 1,244,430 income tax benefit. Without non-operating items it would have been a loss of 715,902.
- **Cash:** 713,481 at the end of June, down 215,543 from May and down 1,871,836 from six months earlier.

**"Other" category:** one expense account, General Expenses, matched no category rule and is grouped as "Other Opex".

**For the reviewer:**
- **Possible one-off items:** December 2025's stock-based compensation (334,661) and bonus (80,343) each appear to be single-month items; the reviewer should confirm.
- **Bad Debts credit:** June's Bad Debts is a credit of 1,806, down from a 12,935 expense in May. This is most of the Finance & Admin drop. It isn't flagged as a one-off, so I only described it.
